title: Terraform module: audited logging stack (CloudTrail -> S3 -> OpenSearch) with KMS and retention automation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisiones the audited logging pipeline we use for Private (VPC) deployments: multi-region CloudTrail delivery into a cross-account S3 audit bucket, automated ingestion into OpenSearch (managed or self-hosted per private deployment), KMS encryption for at-rest logs, and enforceable retention/ILM policies. The module must be parameterizable for: account/region targets, encryption key ARNs, OpenSearch cluster endpoints and index templates, retention window, snapshot schedule, and compliance-safe defaults. Provide upgrade guidance and CI tests so customers can upgrade with minimal downtime.
scope_in: Terraform module distribution in registry + examples
CloudTrail multi-region configuration and cross-account S3 bucket lifecycle
KMS key usage patterns and key policy examples for central logging account
OpenSearch index template + ILM policy creation for CloudTrail and application logs
Automated snapshot exports to S3 and retention enforcement
Health checks: ingestion lag, S3 delivery errors, OpenSearch cluster/index health, ILM execution status
Documentation and upgrade guide (minor/major migration steps)
Automated acceptance tests (Terratest or Terraform validate + synthetic events)
scope_out: Managed hosted Elasticsearch clusters outside our supported deployment modes
Application-level log parsing and enrichment (we provide templates, not custom parsers)
Long-term cold storage beyond configured S3 snapshots (customers may add separately)
design_notes: Use a single module that composes smaller child modules: s3-audit-bucket, cloudtrail, opensearch-ingest, kms-key
S3 bucket must support server-side encryption with KMS and object lock disabled by default (customers can opt-in)
CloudTrail should create a dedicated delivery S3 prefix and put-object tagging to indicate origin & region
OpenSearch ingestion uses an index-per-day pattern with rollover + ILM policy to roll to cold/ snapshot stages
Prefer snapshot lifecycle to delete indices older than retention window to satisfy compliance, include a dry-run flag in module
Expose metrics: s3:PutObject errors, cloudtrail:DeliveryErrors, opensearch:ingest_lag_seconds (derived), opensearch_cluster_health
Module must not enable public access; enforce VPC endpoints when used in Private deployments
implementation_tasks: Create top-level module with inputs/outputs and child modules
Implement cross-account S3 bucket ownership and ACLs via aws_s3_bucket_ownership_controls and aws_s3_bucket_policy
CloudTrail resource: multi-region trail, S3 target, SNS topic for delivery failures
KMS: create key resource template and example key policy for cross-account decrypt/describe
OpenSearch: index template, ILM policy, ingest pipeline example for CloudTrail JSON -> ECS-like mapping
Snapshots: create automated daily snapshots to S3 + lifecycle policy enforcement
Health checks: Terraform resources for CloudWatch event rules/alarms + optional Lambda canary that writes test event
Write examples folder: minimal private deployment + enterprise with cross-account central logging
CI: terraform fmt/checks, unit tests, Terratest e2e that simulates CloudTrail events
Docs: README, upgrade guide, Terraform input reference, security considerations
acceptance_criteria: Module can provision CloudTrail -> S3 in a fresh AWS account with KMS encryption and without manual post-provision steps
Provisioned OpenSearch index receives synthetic CloudTrail events within 60s in canary account
ILM policy rolls over indices and enforces configured retention (test with short retention in sandbox account)
Cross-account S3 writes succeed from a remote account when module is configured with central logging account
Automated CI tests pass in pipeline and documentation covers upgrade path for v1 -> v2
Security review signed off and KMS key policy examples included in README
testing_plan: Unit: terraform validate + sentinel/opa policies for disallowed configs (no public S3, encryption required)
Integration: Terratest deploy to sandbox, generate synthetic CloudTrail events via PutEvents, assert S3 and OpenSearch ingestion
Chaos: simulate delivery failure to verify SNS alarm triggers and documented runbook
Upgrade: deploy module v1 to sandbox, run migration scripts to v2, verify zero data loss and index continuity
Performance: measure ingestion lag and opensearch ingest-throttle under burst of events
Manual: security team runs key policy review and approves example
rollout_plan: Publish module to internal registry as prerelease (v0.1.0-rc)
Apply to internal central logging account in canary OU and validate for 72 hours
Open beta to two customer private deployments with opt-in and monitored telemetry
Gradually mark GA after feedback and iterate on defaults
Provide automated migration tooling for existing stacks using our older audit module
rollback_plan: If ingestion errors spike, disable ingest pipeline via parameterized flag and fall back to S3-only export
Restore OpenSearch index templates from snapshot and reindex if mapping regressions detected
Revert to previous module version via Terraform state rollback in canary account before promoting changes
Escalation steps: paging on-call infra + runbook to remediate KMS key policy issues
